subject: Request: confirm service gap for procurement impact letter
messages:
From: Lucy Park <lucy@stellarretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T23:42:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed gap? Need impact letter for procurement

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Quick note from procurement: we saw a spike of 504/timeout errors during our Blackbox ingest between 2026-11-19 22:05 UTC and 2026-11-19 22:37 UTC (our national checkout window). This affected approx. 3.2% of checkout requests (sampled). Finance/procurement have requested an "impact letter" that confirms the outage window and a short description of root cause for their vendor reconciliation.

Can you confirm the exact service gap (start/end) from Redwood's side and provide a one-page impact letter (we need it in PDF) by Monday so we can push the paperwork through? Also please include any evidence bundle (trace IDs or log snippets) we can pass to our SRE team.

Procurement contact: procurement@stellarretail.com
Regards,
Lucy Park
Director, Platform Engineering
StellarRetail

- We'll attach a short evidence pack with representative trace IDs and a concise technical paragraph describing the immediate cause.

Forwarding Lucy's request to David for telemetry & RCAs. David — early investigation notes: our routing metrics show a rapid concurrency spike during 2026-11-19T22:03–22:38Z in us-west-2, correlated with an autoscaler oscillation on the canary fleet. The canary rollback triggered a KV-cache invalidation and several cold-starts for long-lived streaming sessions; this produced increased queue times and upstream 504s for some customers.

Lucy — cc'ing David from infra so he can pull traces. David, if you can pull three representative trace IDs and a short log snippet for the hours 22:00–23:00 UTC, that'll help the procurement submission.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy@stellarretail.com>, procurement@stellarretail.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Impact letter + evidence plan — StellarRetail (DEAL-4831)

Lucy / Procurement team —

Thanks for the patience. Short update and commitments:

1) Service gap (Redwood canonical): 2026-11-19T22:03:14Z -> 2026-11-19T22:37:44Z (total ~34m 30s). This window is the period where our availability SLO crossed the defined threshold for impacted streaming/checkouts in us-west-2.

2) Immediate cause: an automated canary rollback triggered an autoscaler hot-loop on a subset of the canary pool. That led to repeated container restarts, a localized KV-cache purge, and a series of cold initializations for streaming endpoints. The net effect was queue saturation for longer-running requests and a rise in 504s. The problem was isolated to the canary subset and did not affect the entire regional fleet.

3) Evidence pack (incoming): David will provide —
   - three representative trace IDs with span breakdowns (traces: trace-8a3, trace-9b7, trace-c12)
   - a zipped log excerpt covering 2026-11-19T21:55:00Z -> 2026-11-19T23:00:00Z (redwood_usw2_logs_part.zip, stub)
   - a short CSV summarizing error percentages by minute for the impacted window.

4) Impact letter: attached is a one-page draft in PDF (we will produce final signed PDF on letterhead). The draft includes the canonical window, the technical summary above, and an assurance that we're issuing a formal postmortem to the account team within 7 business days.

5) Compensation route: we will evaluate prorated remediation consistent with our SLA. I'll open a compensation evaluation ticket; finance will route it according to DEAL-4831 terms and provide a proposal within 5 business days.

Attachments (drafts): impact_letter_draft.pdf (stub), requesting_logs_list.txt (stub)

If procurement needs any additional form language, please flag. We'll also share the postmortem once David completes the telemetry pull.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
